name: ab_abundant_def
statement: (n : ℕ) : Nat.Abundant n ↔ 2 * n < ∑ d ∈ Nat.divisors n, d
closed: ∀ (n : ℕ), Nat.Abundant n ↔ 2 * n < ∑ d ∈ Nat.divisors n, d
informal: Paper's definition of abundant (all divisors sum to more than 2n) agrees with Mathlib's Nat.Abundant (proper divisors sum > n).
original: An abundant number is an integer n whose divisors add up to more than 2n. A perfect number is an integer n whose divisors add up to exactly 2n.
type: ∀ (n : ℕ), n.Abundant ↔ 2 * n < ∑ d ∈ n.divisors, d
